project: Why can only some cells become other cells?
scientific_conclusion: Cell-fate restriction is reinforced by coupled gene-regulatory, epigenetic, lineage-history, and niche constraints, but selected boundaries can be crossed by engineered reprogramming. A credible source-to-target claim requires separate proof of provenance, multimodal identity, time-resolved route, target-relevant function, stability, and safety; it is not a clinical cell-therapy conclusion.
independent_review_reason: The deliverable is a static, design-only research document with no high-risk architecture, security, persistence, or data-migration modification.
